answer: Audits are recorded in raven, queued in shale, and pigment publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 80 identities per epoch. A farm of 85 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1225 identities would post 1265 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
